title: Open a new savings sub-account for a member
description: Opens a new Savings sub-account for an existing member in Meridian with the given nickname and initial deposit, confirms it, and returns the new account number. This posts a change to the core; the confirm step is risky and needs sign-off.

nickname.description: Friendly name for the new sub-account

account_number.description: The new sub-account number shown on the confirmation screen
